info.title: How is &ha; achieved for &hana; and &sap; applications?

abstract.para: Learn about &ha; for &hana; and other &sap; applications included in &sles4sap;.

topic.para: &suse; &ha; for the &hana; database is based on HANA system replication. The &ha; solution includes resource agents, HA/DR provider hook scripts and tools for specific cluster administration tasks. The solution can be installed through the sles_sap_HADB pattern.

&hana; &ha; uses the Advanced Next Generation Interface (ANGI) resource agents delivered in the SAPHanaSR-angi package. SAPHanaSR-angi supports various scenarios, including &hana; XSA stand-alone. The recommended progressive variant configuration allows SAPHanaSR-angi a faster takeover in certain scenarios and is more resilient against administration mistakes during maintenance. SAPHanaSR-angi can also, in certain cases, react to cluster-external environment problems, such as NFS outages. A list of supported solutions is documented in HA Solutions for &hana; using SAPHanaSR-angi.

&ha; for &s4h; central services is based on the &sap; Enqueue Standalone Architecture 2 (ENSA2). The solution integrates the HA cluster with the &sap; basic administration framework through the sap-suse-cluster-connector package. This integration greatly simplifies cluster administration tasks. The solution can be installed through the sles_sap_HAAPP pattern. A list of supported solutions is documented in HA Solutions for &s4h; and &netweaver;.
